paras.text: Coventry Patmore (23 July 18 23 – 26 November 1896 ) was an English Victorian poet and critic best known for his narrative poem about the Victorian ideal of a happy marriage 'the Angel in the house.' Patmore was employed in the British museum upon the publication of his first book of poems in 1844. After the death of his first wife, the grief of loss became in great measure, his later theme. Like many Victorians, Coventry Patmore was a deeply religious man who readily and sincerely associated the ordinary happenings of everyday life with his religious beliefs. This poem is an example of it.
paras.urdu: کوونٹری پیٹمور (23 جولائی 1823 – 26 نومبر 1896) ایک انگریز وکٹورین شاعر اور نقاد تھے جو خوشگوار ازدواجی زندگی کے وکٹورین آئیڈیل پر اپنی بیانیہ نظم ’’دی اینجل ان دی ہاؤس‘‘ کے لیے سب سے زیادہ مشہور ہیں۔ 1844 میں ان کی نظموں کی پہلی کتاب شائع ہونے پر انہیں برٹش میوزیم میں ملازمت ملی۔ پہلی بیوی کی وفات کے بعد جدائی کا غم بڑی حد تک ان کا بعد کا موضوع بن گیا۔ بہت سے وکٹورین لوگوں کی طرح کوونٹری پیٹمور ایک گہرے مذہبی انسان تھے جو روزمرہ زندگی کے عام واقعات کو آسانی اور خلوص سے اپنے مذہبی عقائد سے جوڑ دیتے تھے۔ یہ نظم اس کی ایک مثال ہے۔

About the Poet

Coventry Patmore (23 July 18 23 – 26 November 1896 ) was an English Victorian poet and critic best known for his narrative poem about the Victorian ideal of a happy marriage 'the Angel in the house.' Patmore was employed in the British museum upon the publication of his first book of poems in 1844. After the death of his first wife, the grief of loss became in great measure, his later theme. Like many Victorians, Coventry Patmore was a deeply religious man who readily and sincerely associated the ordinary happenings of everyday life with his religious beliefs. This poem is an example of it.

sections.content:
About the Poet

Coventry Patmore (23 July 18 23 – 26 November 1896 ) was an English Victorian poet and critic best known for his narrative poem about the Victorian ideal of a happy marriage 'the Angel in the house.' Patmore was employed in the British museum upon the publication of his first book of poems in 1844. After the death of his first wife, the grief of loss became in great measure, his later theme. Like many Victorians, Coventry Patmore was a deeply religious man who readily and sincerely associated the ordinary happenings of everyday life with his religious beliefs. This poem is an example of it.

Glossary

rows: a kind of wild flower with a cluster of small bell-shaped blue flowers growing on a long stem.
the almost extinct breath in the unconsciousness before death.
ایک قسم کا جنگلی پھول جس کی لمبی ڈنڈی پر گھنٹی نما چھوٹے نیلے پھولوں کا گچھا ہوتا ہے۔
موت سے پہلے بے ہوشی میں تقریباً ختم ہوتی سانس۔
یو ډول ځنګلي ګل چې پر اوږده ډنډ یې د زنګ په بڼه د کوچنیو شنو ګلانو ګېډۍ وي.
له مرګ مخکې په بې‌هوښۍ کې نږدې ختمه شوې ساه.

paras.text: 1. What is the theme of the poem 'The Toys'?

paras.text: 2. The story behind the poem "The Toys" is a homely one. Narrate the story in your own words.
paras.urdu: 2. نظم ’’کھلونے‘‘ کے پیچھے کہانی ایک گھریلو کہانی ہے۔ کہانی اپنے الفاظ میں بیان کریں۔

paras.text: 3. What verse style has been adopted by the poet in the poem,' The toys '?

paras.text: 5. What is the symbolic significance of the word "Toys" in light of the poem 'The Toys'?

paras.pashto: 5. د "لوبونې" شعر په رڼا کې د "لوبونې" کلمې سمبولیک اهمیت څه دی؟

paras.text: 6. How does the poet relate his own action to the mercy of God?
paras.urdu: 6. شاعر اپنے عمل کو خدا کی رحمت سے کیسے جوڑتا ہے؟
paras.pashto: 6. شاعر خپله کړنه د خدای له رحمت سره څنګه تړي؟

paras.text: 7. What is the tone of the poem "The Toys"? Do you think it is in conformity with the theme of the poem? How?

paras.text: Paraphrase the following lines:

paras.text: "Then, fatherly not less
paras.urdu: تو پدرانہ شفقت میں اس سے کم نہیں
paras.pashto: نو د پلارنۍ مینې له مخې له هغه کم نه

paras.text: Than I whom Thou hast moulded from the clay,
paras.urdu: جتنا میں ہوں جسے تو نے مٹی سے گوندھا،

Reading Comprehension

1. What is the theme of the poem 'The Toys'?

2. The story behind the poem "The Toys" is a homely one. Narrate the story in your own words.

3. What verse style has been adopted by the poet in the poem,' The toys '?

4. Does this style suit the mood of the poem and how?

5. What is the symbolic significance of the word "Toys" in light of the poem 'The Toys'?

6. How does the poet relate his own action to the mercy of God?

7. What is the tone of the poem "The Toys"? Do you think it is in conformity with the theme of the poem? How?

8. What feelings does the poem "The Toys" evoke in you?

Writing Suggestions

Paraphrase the following lines:

"Then, fatherly not less

Than I whom Thou hast moulded from the clay,

Thou'lt leave Thy wrath and say,

Oral Communication

6. The weather is rather ________ today. You should take a rain jacket.

7. Next week will be hot and ________.

8. The weather is ________ this week. I wish it would rain.

4. کیا یہ اسلوب نظم کی کیفیت سے مطابقت رکھتا ہے اور کیسے؟

5. نظم ’’کھلونے‘‘ کی روشنی میں لفظ ’’کھلونے‘‘ کی علامتی اہمیت کیا ہے؟

6. شاعر اپنے عمل کو خدا کی رحمت سے کیسے جوڑتا ہے؟

7. نظم ’’کھلونے‘‘ کا لہجہ کیا ہے؟ کیا آپ کے خیال میں یہ نظم کے موضوع سے ہم آہنگ ہے؟ کیسے؟

8. نظم ’’کھلونے‘‘ آپ میں کون سے جذبات ابھارتی ہے؟

تحریری تجاویز

درج ذیل اشعار کی نثر میں وضاحت (پیرا فریز) کریں:

تو پدرانہ شفقت میں اس سے کم نہیں

جتنا میں ہوں جسے تو نے مٹی سے گوندھا،

تو اپنا غضب چھوڑ دے گا اور کہے گا،

’’مجھے ان کے بچپنے پر افسوس ہو گا‘‘۔

زبانی ابلاغ

جماعت کے سامنے اپنے تجربے، احساسات اور جذبات کا زبانی بیان دیں اگر آپ کے والدین میں سے کسی نے آپ سے ویسا ہی سلوک کیا ہو جیسا نظم ’’کھلونے‘‘ میں بیان ہوا ہے۔

ذخیرۂ الفاظ اور قواعد

A. نیچے دی گئی فہرست سے موسم سے متعلق موزوں الفاظ کے ساتھ درج ذیل خالی جگہیں پُر کریں۔

1. آج بہت ________ ہے۔ میرا خیال ہے یہ شمالی ہوا ہے۔

2. ان کی شادی جون کے ایک ________، دھوپ والے دن ہوئی۔

3. سائیکل کی سیر کے لیے موسم ________ ہونے تک انتظار کریں۔

4. کچھ لوگ دھوپ کے بجائے ________ موسم میں پیدل سفر پسند کرتے ہیں۔

5. مجھے ________، سرد دن ناپسند ہیں جب میں گرم نہیں ہو پاتا۔

6. آج موسم کچھ ________ ہے۔ آپ کو بارش کی جیکٹ ساتھ لے جانی چاہیے۔

7. اگلا ہفتہ گرم اور ________ ہو گا۔

8. اس ہفتے موسم ________ ہے۔ کاش بارش ہو جائے۔

sections.content:
Reading Comprehension

1. What is the theme of the poem 'The Toys'?

2. The story behind the poem "The Toys" is a homely one. Narrate the story in your own words.

3. What verse style has been adopted by the poet in the poem,' The toys '?

4. Does this style suit the mood of the poem and how?

5. What is the symbolic significance of the word "Toys" in light of the poem 'The Toys'?

6. How does the poet relate his own action to the mercy of God?

7. What is the tone of the poem "The Toys"? Do you think it is in conformity with the theme of the poem? How?

8. What feelings does the poem "The Toys" evoke in you?

Writing Suggestions

Paraphrase the following lines:

"Then, fatherly not less

Than I whom Thou hast moulded from the clay,

Thou'lt leave Thy wrath and say,

'I will be sorry for their childishness'.

Oral Communication

Give oral recount in front of class of your experience, feelings emotions if you had been treated by one of your parents the same way as narrated in poem 'Toys'.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Fill in the following blanks with appropriate words related to weather given in the list below.

1. It's very ________ today. I think it's a northern wind.

2. They got married on a ________, sunny day in June.

3. Wait till the weather is ________ to take a bike ride.

4. Some people prefer to hike when it's ________ rather than when it's sunny.

5. I hate ________, cold days when I can't warm up.

6. The weather is rather ________ today. You should take a rain jacket.

7. Next week will be hot and ________.

8. The weather is ________ this week. I wish it would rain.
